description: This file defines an OAuthManager class that handles OAuth2.0 token management, including token refresh, validation, and request handling, with support for credential synchronization and token lifecycle methods.

classes.name: OAuthManager
classes.description: A class that manages OAuth2.0 tokens, including automatic refresh, validation, request handling, and credential sync support.

methods.name: getTokenObjectOrFetch
methods.description: Retrieves the current token object if valid, or refreshes and fetches a new one if expired.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends an authenticated request, handling token refresh and invalidation based on response.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Sends a raw fetch request with authorization header, without automatic token validation.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the current token, expiring or marking it invalid depending on credential sync.

methods.name: normalizeNewlyReceivedToken
methods.description: Normalizes token object, setting expiry date if missing.

methods.name: refreshOAuthToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth token via credential sync endpoint or fetch method.

methods.name: getAndValidateOAuth2Response
methods.description: Validates OAuth2 response, checking token usability and response status.
